about.title: Vision, Context, and Tectonics
about.description: Fourth-year architecture student passionate about the intersection of architecture, computation, and international real estate development. Skilled in Revit, Rhino, Grasshopper, and BIM workflows developed across internships in three countries, with hands-on experience translating design concepts into buildable, resource-efficient outcomes. Brings integrated technical and cross-cultural skills strengthened through internships and study programs in the United States, Japan, Italy, and Taiwan.
